status: Frozen locally before public-sequence probe runs; not independent preregistration

source_terms.license: CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0; original-source conditions may also apply
source_terms.use: Local non-commercial research; inputs and per-frame results not redistributed

detector: Reuse exact YOLO26n CPU 8.4.176 caches from admission study; no new detection/model/parameter change
observation: Instance-only wrappers forward exact original arrays, gates and original decisions. No GT enters tracking. Raw matrices/rows/IDs and full events remain local.
trace_fields: Actual gate and chosen/unmatched row/column indices
Track confirmation counters, retained age and private tokens
Matched tentative promotion or confirmed recovery after >=1 prior missed frame

definitions.opportunity: Each confirmed retained hypothesis/frame with >=1 prior miss, not unique objects or independent trials
definitions.residual_valid_edge: Both endpoints remain unmatched after solve-then-filter, but score meets the stage gate
definitions.cost_scope: Stage-specific IoU or score-fused IoU; 1-similarity is an equivalent assignment objective, not appearance/Mahalanobis probability
definitions.posthoc_join: Official CLEAR TP/FP/exclusion and last-known GT identity, geometric raw support, low visibility <=.3; observational contexts only

planned_outputs: Promotion TP/FP/exclusion and stage ambiguity/cost distributions
Confirmed recovery same/different/unknown prior official GT and costs/gap lengths
All per-scene outputs exactly match prior canonical predictions and official CLEAR/Identity/HOTA; repeated probe traces equal
selection_rule: Choose next research control point from reproducible bottlenecks with explicit denominators and TP/FP trade-offs. No threshold retuning, control intervention, default promotion or independent acceptance claim.
limitations: Reused MOT17 training scenes, not independent validation.
Missed-frame recovery is not proof of physical occlusion; last official GT ownership may already be contaminated.
Only retained hypotheses are observed; expired/missing hypotheses have no association matrix row.
No performance claim: probe overhead and local trace writes invalidate latency comparison.
No source imagery, GT, per-frame IDs, raw diagnostics, local paths, user notes or credentials published.
